faq_heading: Richmond houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Richmond house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 39 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $2,200,000, with the middle half between $1,923,928 and $2,677,500. Every Richmond detached house had a median of $1,741,500.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Richmond?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 39 Richmond houses sold with a legal suite and 40 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,800,000.

faq.q: How big can a suite be in Richmond?
faq.a: At least 33.0 square metres and no more than the lesser of 40% of the dwelling’s floor area or 110 square metres, under section 5.4 of Zoning Bylaw No. 8500.

faq.q: Which Richmond zones list a secondary suite?
faq.a: RS1 and RS2, the single detached zones, list a secondary suite as a secondary use.

faq.q: Which Richmond neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: West Cambie had 9 legal-suite sales, Riverdale 4 and Seafair 4 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Richmond houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 44 days at a median, closing at 93.4% of list, with 0% over the list price.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Richmond that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Seafair (45), Steveston South (30), Steveston North (30), West Cambie (25) and Riverdale (23). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 496 detached houses that closed in Richmond between November 1 and August 31, 79 (16%) had a suite: 39 legal and 40 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $2,200,000, 26% more than the $1,741,500 median for every Richmond house.

blocks.text: The typical legal-suite house sits on 6,731 sq ft, against 6,319 sq ft for all Richmond houses. It has 3,282 square feet of floor area, against 2,610. 97% of legal-suite houses have two or more kitchens, compared with 39% of all houses. Unauthorized-suite houses were smaller at 2,938 square feet and a median $1,800,000.

Alongside suites, 28 Richmond houses had lane access, at a median of $1,709,900; 3 had a second residence on the lot. These are separate flags in the same Paragon records, and a house can carry more than one.

blocks.text: Richmond’s Zoning Bylaw No. 8500 lists a secondary suite as a secondary use in the single detached zones RS1 and RS2. Section 5.4 sets the size window: at least 33.0 square metres, and at most the lesser of 40% of the dwelling’s floor area or 110 square metres.

The City says it allows at least one secondary suite or accessory dwelling unit on each lot, and the provincial minimums for small-scale multi-unit housing apply: 3 units on a lot of 280 square metres or less, and 4 on a larger one.

Richmond sits behind 49 kilometres of dikes, and Richmond Fire-Rescue notes that pockets of liquefaction are possible in a significant earthquake. For a below-grade suite, ask for its permit and age and whether the lot has had water problems.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in Richmond was $1,871,100 in September 2026, 8.5% down over twelve months. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Before you offer on a Richmond house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Richmond permit and final inspection for the suite. 40 of the 79 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.
Ask for the building permit and the final inspection for the suite, and confirm the suite is within the 110 square metre and 40% limits in Zoning Bylaw No. 8500.

Measure the suite against the limit of the lesser of 40% of the dwelling and 110 square metres (1,184 square feet). On the median Richmond legal-suite house of 3,282 square feet, 40% comes to about 1,310 square feet.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 44 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,800,000 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $2,200,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
